assets.purpose: Symbolic supplementary Approvals & Tasks illustration for landing tab and welcome aside; core UI remains semantic HTML.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: supplementary illustration for Anumat ERP Approvals & Tasks pages, beside real accessible HTML copy
Primary request: a compact coherent still life of two cream paperwork/task sheets with thick cobalt-blue edges, a mint completed check token, a small connected checklist, and a due-date calendar tile. The checklist uses only simple check shapes and short abstract rules. The calendar has small blank cells, no lettering or numerals.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background, isolated objects with soft dimensional contact shadows only; no backdrop scene or ground plane.
Style/medium: tactile handmade 3D paper/cardboard/clay illustration; softly rounded sturdy forms, visible fine paper grain, speckled matte surfaces, shallow layered depth. Friendly professional visual for an approachable enterprise app.
Composition/framing: square approximately 1024 by 1024 canvas; a single compact cluster, gentle three-quarter view, generous transparent margin on every side, every object fully visible with no clipping. Overlap the two upright paper sheets slightly and place the check token and small calendar tile in front; keep all elements connected as one still life, no floating decoration.
Lighting/mood: soft studio light from upper left, warm calm dimensional shadows.
Color palette: bright cobalt blue, pale mint green, soft lavender, warm cream, and a very modest coral accent.
Materials/textures: grainy recycled paper and painted cardboard with clay-like bevels; crisp silhouettes and softly imperfect tactile texture.
Text: no text whatsoever.
Constraints: symbolic supplementary imagery only, no real UI screenshot, no logos, no watermark, no legible text, no letters, no numerals; no background color or scene, no confetti or floating decorative shapes; preserve actual alpha transparency.
assets.optimization: Pillow Lanczos resize from 1254 square to 1024 square; WebP quality 84, method 6, exact true; generated alpha preserved.
